heading.title: Rules in cases of Intestates other than Parsis

article.title: Where intestate’s father living.
article.content: If the intestate’s father is living, he shall succeed to the property.
article.html:
42Where intestate’s father living.

Section 42 · Part V · Chapter II · page 24 of the Act

If the intestate’s father is living, he shall succeed to the property.
